chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
That he was asked about a man entering the bathhouse while he is fasting, so he said: “There is no harm so long as he does not fear weakness.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the Imam being asked
key_terms.الْعَلَاءُ: Al-ʿAlāʾ, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: Muḥammad ibn Muslim, a prominent transmitter from the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a fasting person to enter the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a fasting person entering the bathhouse. It indicates permissibility as long as doing so is not feared to cause weakness that may negatively affect the fast.
